gates.name: M8.4_gameplay
gates.evidence: Partial: AETHER-01 authors its mission as the cooked quest Content/Gameplay/FirstContact.aquest (one flag objective per checkpoint stage; MissionStage is derived from Quests progress and the quest log is rebuilt from the save on reopen) and firing as the cooked FireWeapon.aability paying the AmmoCost.aeffect (an empty magazine fails with cannot_afford), driven from Luau through the public Quests/Abilities/Attributes/SaveGames APIs; checkpoints via SaveGames. Proven on the cooked pak by Aether01_CookedQuestAndFireAbilityUseThePublicKits plus the existing Aether01_* checkpoint/combat tests; games/AETHER-01 needs no engine source changes. Open: the steps and time for a new developer have not been recorded, per-weapon fire cooldowns stay script timers rather than cooldown effects, and hot reload of the kit assets is not exercised (reopen is)

gates.name: M8.5_content
gates.evidence: Repeat cook byte-identical with zero imports/texture cooks and an edited test_cube.bin re-importing exactly its 22 models (Linux GCC step "Content pipeline evidence (M8.5)", Cook_RepeatBuildsAreByteIdentical, ModelImport_EditingTheBufferFileReimports; the step logs sha256, git revision, gcc and cmake versions); importer validation by Cook_InvalidSourcesAreReportedByPathWithTheReason (corrupt/truncated PNG, malformed glTF, glTF with a missing buffer, WAV without fmt/data, invalid prefab JSON and a missing always_cook path each reported with the content path and reason, good assets still cooked, strict cook writes no archive); standalone pak load by the same Linux step (the pak run headless in aether_player from an empty directory with the project sources moved away, no errors or kit-asset warnings) and the Windows packaged AETHER-01.exe check (source tree hidden, empty cwd, recook hash equal). Green on CI for PR #691 (Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS). Note: kit assets (.aquest/.aability/.aeffect/.aitem) are validated by the player at load, not by the cooker

gates.name: M8.6_character
gates.evidence: Partial: generated skinned Kael rig + 13-clip move set + Kael.aanim graph (tools/generate_aether01_kael_rig.py; Kael_Recon has no skin, so the rig is a stand-in and is not rendered skinned), driven from ThirdPersonController.luau through Animator methods and run by the new player animation host (Game::Animation, Player.Animation, 'Anim state' markers). Kael_MoveSetTransitionsMatchAt30_60_144HzAndVariableDt (same 22 transitions, param-driven within one frame, clip exits within one frame of the authored state time, crossfade weights sum to 1, pose/root motion match 144 Hz; crossfade root motion now frame-rate independent), Kael_RetargetsOntoTheWardenRigWithBoundedError and Kael_RetargetReportsIncompatibleSkeletonsClearly (ValidateRetarget RT001-RT009), Aether01_KaelMoveSetPlaysInTheCookedGame / Aether01_KaelLocomotionTransitionsAtVariedFrameRates on the cooked pak (fixed a 30 Hz movement-input loss), packaged: tools/aether01_character_check.py replays the move-set trace in standalone aether_player --headless (Linux GCC CI step) - passes locally, not yet run on CI. Missing: CI run, editor play-through, sprint reachable in game, skinned rendering of the rig / production Kael rig, IK/aim/foot offsets and anim events through cook and save/load in the slice

gates.name: M8.9_multiplayer
gates.evidence: Partial: deterministic host + 4-client soak (300 s), 5%/20% loss, 100 ms +/- 30 latency, reconnect and security (garbage, replay, authority, unauthenticated) checks against recorded thresholds (tests/test_net_production.cpp, NetProd_*; table in M8_PRODUCTION_PLAN.md M8.9). Packaged dedicated server: aether_server + aether_netclient (tools/server/), tools/package_server.sh -> aether-server-linux-x64.tar.gz + SHA256SUMS.txt, CI dedicated-server job runs it in a bare ubuntu:24.04 container with 2 clients over real localhost UDP (tools/server_smoke.sh), DedicatedServer_* tests. Security hardening: stateless cookie handshake (no amplification, replay refused), per-session SipHash-2-4 MAC on every datagram (spoofed/forged frames dropped), signed join tokens (aether_server token_secret/--issue-token, aether_netclient --token), per-address rate limits; NetProd_SipHashTestVectors, NetProd_Security*, DedicatedServer_RealUdpJoinTokens, token case in server_smoke.sh. Not encrypted. Dedicated server LAN discovery (lan_advertise/lan_port, aether_netclient --discover/--join-first; padded queries, answer <= query, per-IP rate limit; Session_LanBeaconAntiAmplification, DedicatedServer_RealUdpLanDiscoveryAndProfile, discovery step in server_smoke.sh), network profile capture (aether_server --profile JSONL: per-peer RTT/loss/bytes per channel, snapshot sizes, security and LAN counters; CI artifact dedicated-server-profile; sample summary in M8_PRODUCTION_PLAN.md), Windows x64 zip and macOS arm64 tar.gz server packages with native localhost smokes in the windows/macos CI jobs (CI-only verification), and server packages in release assets + SHA256SUMS + provenance attestation (not yet exercised by a tagged release). Missing: thresholds sign-off (and measuring them against the packaged server), transport encryption decision, cross-machine/NAT run

gates.name: M8.10_build_ship
gates.evidence: Partial: tools/ship/aether_ship.py Linux game package for AETHER-01 with GAME_MANIFEST.json (version, content build_id, git rev, engine/min engine version, toolchain, runtime deps, licenses, pak order, per-file sha256+size, symbols build-ids), stripped player + build-id keyed objcopy symbols archive, release manifest + SHA256SUMS (deterministic packaging); tools/ship/build_release.sh v1 + delta-pak v2 + v1->v2 patch; apply (checksum, base build_id, payload hashes, min engine version, staged verify, two-rename switch, .previous backup) and rollback (swap, user files/saves kept, interrupted switch recovered); CI game-ship job runs tools/ship/ship_smoke.sh in bare ubuntu:24.04 (install, checksums, build-id check, headless launch Health 3, damaged/tampered patch refused with v1 intact, patch -> Health 5, rollback -> Health 3, saves kept) and a release-assembly dry run; Release job adds package/symbols/manifest to SHA256SUMS + attestation on v* tags; Fresh cook reproducible, verified on CI (PR #695: Linux GCC 'Content pipeline evidence (M8.5)' two clean-copy cooks byte-identical; derived sub-asset GUIDs). Windows: aether_ship.py --platform windows-x64 .zip package (AETHER-01.exe + DLLs), .pdb symbol-store zip with SYMBOLS.json GUID/age (PE RSDS vs PDB info/DBI streams), .zip patch, os.replace switching with clear files-in-use errors; MSVC job runs ship_smoke.sh natively and Release adds AETHER-01-windows-x64-ship package/symbols/manifest to SHA256SUMS + attestation (wired, not yet run on CI); ship_tool_tests (29). Missing: CI run of the Windows ship steps and a real tag, macOS game package, game package signing, upgrade from a prior tagged candidate
